summary: On paper Carolina has the edge (Carolina ranks 3rd in EPA per dropback, +0.26), while Philadelphia's best counter is to hold up vs four (Philadelphia ranks 7th in QB hit + sack rate vs 4 or fewer rushers, 14%). Under center, Bryce Young ranks 3rd of 23 in EPA per dropback; x-factor: Chuba Hubbard gains +1.4 rushing yards over expected per carry, 4th of 27, and Philadelphia's run defense ranks 13th. The model favors Carolina at 70%, mostly on starting QB (2.8 pts) and rushing matchup (2.2 pts).

Carolina ranks 10th in broken tackles per touch (5.6%). Philadelphia's defense ranks 28th (11.5% missed).
